protocol.region_rule: first and last disjoint equal regions of each requested size; size is skipped when file_bytes < 2*size; no padding
protocol.selection: per file/size best compressed representation (F) on dev, frozen before validation

controls.C: raw LZMA2 preset 6 plus one selector byte
controls.D: selected coordinate ordering + zstd level 9, no decomposition
controls.G: best of delta, stride-3 shuffle, global add, global xor + zstd level 9

primary.baseline: min(A,B,C,D,G) per region, summed over available sizes per file

low_rank.bottleneck: min(sum E, sum F) > 0.99 * sum baseline on a low-rank file
